written_before_any_scored_run_basis: No SCORED run exists at this commit. docs/evidence/7949-capstone/e1-e2.log predates this record and is UNPREREGISTERED by its own lines (prereg=UNPREREGISTERED, every criterion verdict=UNPREREGISTERED, result=UNPREREGISTERED, exit=3), so it was never compared against a bar and can never be scored against these thresholds. See PRE-REGISTRATION.md section 0 for the disclosed cost: the author of the E1 bar had seen the unscored 60.0%.

corpus.pinned_by: fixture revision (fixtures_hash), not a graph dump

split.discipline: READ discipline over ONE replay: both halves are replayed; only TUNE's per-unit outcomes may inform tuning before the scored run

criteria.metric: `:Object` nodes written by the run whose name satisfies `is_bare_definite_description` (the `^the <X>` shape)
criteria.denominator: **all** `:Object` nodes written by the run, same arm, same commit (floor ≥ 30 Objects)
criteria.threshold_basis: bounded by the shipped positive predicate (9 of 15 shape-in-scope labelled names) and the backfill's measured ~48% delete precision; NOT fitted to the unscored 60.0%

criteria.metric: anti-gaming control: planted units that **strictly** survive (`grading.strict_survival_counts`) on the deterministic `m2` lane (seed 42, judge pin `w2-write-path-mechanical-v2`)
criteria.threshold_basis: anti-gaming control for E1: the m2 baseline is 1.0 at this fixtures_hash, so there is no noise budget to hide in

criteria.metric: value-bearing planted units that **strictly** survive, each named by id if lost
criteria.threshold_basis: 100% would fail on one legitimate reformatting; two losses is a filter eating the carve-out

criteria.metric: surviving planted units whose matched `Point` **also** matches at least one **other** distinct surviving unit (a fused claim)
criteria.threshold_basis: anti-fusion control: EXTRACTOR-V4-ARCHITECTURE section 7 forbids aggregation, so volume cannot be won by fusing claims

criteria.metric: derived nodes written by the run (`Point` + `Object` + `Event`) carrying a version anchor
criteria.denominator: **all** derived nodes written by the run (floor ≥ 30 nodes)
criteria.threshold_basis: an unanchored derivation is a structural defect, not a rate to be traded

criteria.metric: planted operator edges **wired AND persisted** with endpoint refs remapped
criteria.denominator: the **15** planted operator edges of the full 7-session corpus
criteria.threshold_basis: the 15 edge gold replaced a 4-edge denominator that swung 0-2 of 4 on identical code; no rate may ever be reported against 4

criteria.metric: hedge/scope/stance-bearing claims recovered as claims in the **narrative** arm
criteria.denominator: the same claims recovered in the **raw** arm of the same run, both over the **29** marker-bearing sentences (the ratio's denominator); the raw arm's absolute recovery is reported too
criteria.threshold_basis: the ratio alone is degenerate - two arms both at 20% give ratio 1.0 - so the raw absolute floor is required too

conditional.condition: the S2 map left at least one candidate's kind missing or `unclassified`, so `_collect_classify_items` (tortoise/extractor_v2.py:8666, `def _collect_classify_items`) had an item to hand the classifier; when the map types every candidate the pass has no work and neither classify pass runs
conditional.idle_evidence: the run's own classify surface reads enabled=true with empty s2/union, the receipt's error/warning surfaces carry no `classify(S2) failed` / `classify(union) failed` / `classify-later init failed` — the fail-open path leaves the SAME empty counters, so the absence of a failure marker is what separates 'nothing to do' from 'crashed' — AND the receipt's `step_witness` carries a POSITIVE candidate count for the map: an absent or zero count is the shape an EMPTY item set leaves when it skips the pass's `try`, so it cannot support an idle claim (#10215 review r2 P2)

below_floor: REFUSED, which is neither a pass nor a fail
interface_note: The field is written_before_any_scored_run, NOT the unqualified written_before_any_run: the latter is false at this commit because e1-e2.log exists, and a machine consumer keys on the name rather than on this prose (#9075 review P1). The capstone run probe (#9089, open) reads this path as its --prereg-artifact and freezes the corpus it is handed with --corpus. This record freezes the tests/eval/write_path corpus, which is the corpus #9075 pre-registers; a run handed a DIFFERENT corpus must mismatch G1 and be refused, never scored. Reconciling the two corpora is that PR's or a follow-up's job, not something this record may paper over.
